styles.full_suno_prompt:
Mood: Playful, flirty, sunny, charming; courtship, teasing and chemistry.
Vocal: Warm male tenor-baritone, rhythmic and confident; clear Vietnamese diction, smiling delivery, light syncopation, short melodic phrases, natural breath, chorus harmonies.
Genre: Latin Cha-cha-cha × Vietnamese Dance Pop.
Tempo: 116 BPM, 4/4; crisp cha-cha-cha syncopation, C major.
Instruments: Piano montuno, güiro, congas, bongos, claves, cowbell, warm bass, brass stabs, clean guitar and light handclaps.
Production: Bright, organic, danceable; punchy Latin percussion, tight bass, clear upfront vocal, stereo brass, no harsh limiting.
Structure: Percussion intro, bouncy verse, playful pre-chorus, catchy chorus, short brass break, call-and-response bridge, final chorus, clean ending.
Language: Vietnamese.
Theme: Two hearts flirt on a lively dance floor and find the courage to confess.
Avoid: Reggaeton dembow, trap hi-hats, heavy EDM drops, cluttered percussion.

Mood: Euphoric, wistful, energetic, liberating; heartbreak turning into courage.
Vocal: Expressive male baritone with clear Vietnamese diction; intimate verse, airy pre-chorus, strong melodic chorus, controlled vibrato, strong hook; no shouting.
Genre: Vietnamese Dance Pop × Melodic EDM.
Tempo: 124 BPM, 4/4; F minor, uplifting major-color chorus.
Instruments: Bright piano, plucked synth, warm supersaw chords, sidechained bass, four-on-floor kick, claps, crisp hats, risers and pads.
Production: Wide, club-ready, vocal-forward; clean low end, controlled sidechain, smooth build, melodic drop, contrast, short vocal reverb.
Structure: Ambient intro, intimate verse, rising pre-chorus, mighty chorus, melodic drop, second verse, breakdown, final chorus/drop, outro.
Language: Vietnamese.
Theme: Dancing through a breakup toward freedom and a new beginning.
Avoid: Harsh distortion, overcompressed master, dubstep growls, muddy drops, buried vocals.

Mood: Reflective, determined, urban, uplifting; resilience, hope and confidence.
Vocal: Male mid-low, warm and direct; melodic pop hooks with precise rhythmic rap verses, clear Vietnamese diction, natural breath, grit, dynamics; lead upfront.
Genre: Vietnamese Pop × Contemporary Hip-Hop.
Tempo: 94 BPM, 4/4; B minor, relaxed head-nod groove.
Instruments: Punchy kick, snare, crisp hi-hats, sub bass, electric piano, clean guitar, airy synth pads, subtle strings and vocal chops.
Production: Modern, clean, vocal-forward; tight low end, spacious hook, restrained saturation, subtle sidechain, clear rap-melody separation.
Structure: Piano intro, rap verse, melodic pre-chorus, soaring pop hook, rap verse two, stripped bridge, final layered hook, outro.
Language: Vietnamese.
Theme: Rising after setbacks without forgetting family, roots or old dreams.
Avoid: Mumbled lyrics, excessive auto-tune, aggressive drill, muddy sub bass, overcrowded hooks.

Mood: Warm, reflective, nostalgic, tender, hopeful, emotional.
Vocal: Warm male baritone; intimate, expressive, clear Vietnamese diction, natural phrasing, controlled vibrato, restrained emotion. Solo verses, breathy openings, stronger chest voice in pre-chorus, sustained chorus notes; light double-tracking, subtle low and selective third-harmony in chorus, sparse final-line backing, no choir.
Genre: Vietnamese Pop Ballad, Contemporary Ballad.
Tempo: 72–76 BPM, slow-medium, steady 4/4.
Instruments: Piano, acoustic guitar, warm bass, live drums, clean electric guitar, subtle strings, light pads.
Production: Polished, warm, organic, vocal-forward.
Structure: Gentle intro, intimate verses, gradual build, fuller chorus, soft outro.
Language: Vietnamese (clear diction specified).
Theme: Reflective nostalgia, tenderness, hope (from Mood).
Avoid: EDM drops, heavy synths, aggressive drums, distortion, excessive melisma, theatrical delivery.

styles.genre: Latin Rumba Ballad × Vietnamese Romantic Pop.
styles.full_suno_prompt:
Mood: Romantic, tender, yearning, intimate; affection, distance and a promise.
Vocal: Deep male baritone, velvety and sincere; close-mic verses, clear Vietnamese diction, gentle legato, controlled vibrato, sustained notes, gentle chorus lift.
Genre: Latin Rumba Ballad × Vietnamese Romantic Pop.
Tempo: 92 BPM, 4/4; flowing rumba sway, G minor.
Instruments: Nylon-string guitar lead, congas, bongos, claves, shaker, warm bass, soft piano, delicate strings and airy pads.
Production: Warm, spacious, organic; guitar and percussion interlock, vocal upfront, soft ambience, light compression, dynamics.
Structure: Fingerpicked guitar intro, intimate verse, rising pre-chorus, lyrical chorus, guitar answer, second verse, gentle bridge, final chorus, lingering outro.
Language: Vietnamese.
Theme: Lovers separated by distance hold on to a promise beneath the night sky.
Avoid: Aggressive drums, trap, EDM drops, busy solos, theatrical belting.

Mood: Passionate, bittersweet, elegant; desire, jealousy, heartbreak and defiant longing.
Vocal: Mature male baritone, warm and resonant; intimate narrative verses, crisp Vietnamese diction, controlled vibrato, bold unshouted chorus, expressive pauses.
Genre: Argentine Tango × Vietnamese Pop Ballad.
Tempo: 124 BPM, 4/4, marked tango pulse; D minor.
Instruments: Bandoneon lead, violin, piano, nylon guitar, double bass, strings and light percussion; sharp accents and walking bass.
Production: Acoustic, intimate, cinematic; dry rhythmic attacks, warm vocal upfront, short room reverb, clear bandoneon-vocal separation.
Structure: Bandoneon intro, poised verse, rising pre-chorus, passionate chorus, instrumental tango break, tense bridge, final chorus, dramatic stop.
Language: Vietnamese.
Theme: Two former lovers dance once more before their final goodbye.
Avoid: EDM drops, trap drums, cartoonish accordion, excessive ornament, muddy bass.

styles.genre: C-Ballad x Slow Rock x Ancient Chinese Folk.
styles.full_suno_prompt:
Mood: Nostalgic, tender, sunlit, quietly aching; pure, unreachable schoolyard love.
Vocal: Deep male bass-baritone, resonant, warm, weathered, dignified; grounded low register, firm chest resonance, clear forward phrasing, steady breath, slow controlled vibrato. Noble restraint in verses; broader, more powerful chorus, never shouted; loyalty, memory, rising collective pride.
Genre: C-Ballad x Slow Rock x Ancient Chinese Folk.
Tempo: 66–70 BPM, slow 6/8 pacing.
Instruments: Guqin, guzheng, pipa, erhu, xiao, dizi, yangqin, zhongruan, sheng, bianzhong, muyu, dagu, deep bass; Chinese classical palette.
Production: Spacious, tragic, elegant; natural hall reverb, clear upfront vocal.
Structure: Sparse verses and restrained slow-rock chorus lift.
Language: Not specified.
Theme: First summer love stays unspoken, a lifelong wound.
Avoid: EDM, trap, rap cadence, bright teen-pop, shouting, muddy mix.

styles.genre: Vietnamese Sentimental Bolero × Modern Pop Ballad.
styles.full_suno_prompt:
Mood: Melancholic, nostalgic, intimate, bittersweet; rural love divided by family, class and impossible marriage.
Vocal: Male mid-low, warm, mature, emotional, clear; natural breath, intimate phrasing, restrained vibrato, subtle bolero ornamentation. Lead upfront, centered, dominant.
Genre: Vietnamese Sentimental Bolero × Modern Pop Ballad.
Tempo: 72 BPM, 4/4, A minor.
Instruments: Nylon and acoustic guitars lead; warm bass, soft piano, accordion, strings, brushed drums, light percussion. Guitars pulse; piano and accordion answer; strings rise at emotional peaks.
Production: Vocal-forward, controlled compression, light reverb, clear diction; duck instruments beneath vocals.
Structure: Sparse intro and verses, rising pre-chorus, wide chorus, soft post-chorus, short instrumental break, restrained bridge, stronger final chorus, warm organic outro.
Language: Vietnamese.
Theme: Love denied by family and social distance.
Avoid: Not specified.

styles.genre: Vietnamese Pop Ballad × Melodic Rap with cinematic ambience.
styles.full_suno_prompt:
Mood: Ethereal, nostalgic, romantic, melancholic, haunting; village heartbreak, class divide, family opposition, rainy road, impossible marriage.
Vocal: Strong emotional male, clear, powerful storytelling; natural breath, airy phrasing, restrained vibrato, smooth melodic rap. Lead upfront, centered, dominant.
Genre: Vietnamese Pop Ballad × Melodic Rap with cinematic ambience.
Tempo: 78 BPM, 4/4, A minor; chorus lifts toward C major.
Instruments: Acoustic and nylon guitars, soft piano, warm bass, strings, pads, subtle electronic drums, percussion.
Production: Vocal-forward, clear; compression, light reverb, clear diction; duck instruments, keep piano and strings behind singer.
Structure: Sparse intro/verses, rising pre-chorus, catchy wide chorus; rap over Am-F-C-G, Dm7-Em7-E7 tension; minimal bridge, final cinematic chorus.
Language: Vietnamese.
Theme: Rural love blocked by family and class, ending in separation.
Avoid: Not specified.

Mood: Heartbroken, nostalgic; reunion ten years too late, lost love, silent regret.
Vocal: Deep male raspy aged baritone, warm, sorrowful; story-like restraint, long sob-like vibrato, subtle cracks. Intimate low verses, chest resonance, audible breaths, delayed end vibrato, natural imperfections; never theatrical or shouted. Choruses rise with wounded dignity.
Genre: Vietnamese Ballad 6/8 x Chinese Folk.
Tempo: 61 BPM, D minor, 6/8.
Instruments: Lead tenor saxophone, warm, breathy, aching; long sustains, slow bends, soft falls, restrained vibrato. Support: piano, guzheng, pipa, dizi, mournful erhu, soft cello.
Production: Spacious, dark, cinematic; clear separation between voice and sax, soft reverb.
Structure: Lonely sax intro, intimate verses, wider choruses, suspended bridge, sax-led final climax, fading outro.
Language: Vietnamese.
Theme: Ten-year-late reunion and irretrievable love.
Avoid: Theatrical delivery and shouting.
